title: The Last Garden Revisited
author: S. M. Whitlock
blurb: Ansel Vane, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
